title: The Sugar Pane on the Window Biscuit
youtube_title: The Sugar Pane on the Window Biscuit | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Pema wants to check on a window biscuit with a sugar pane before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Pema leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
